scope: Contact-model equation only; global beta_c not identified; no elementary nonexistence theorem claimed.

recognition.meaning: bounded heuristic recognition; not proof of transcendence or absence of elementary closed form

symbolic_checks.monodromy_factor: exp(4*pi*mu), positive and greater than one
symbolic_checks.role: Verifies symbolic identities, not the invoked transcendence theorems.

negative_results: No numerical recognition result was found; a bounded PSLQ search is not exhaustive exclusion.

First local run failed a syntactic equality assertion comparing expanded and factored identical polynomials. Replacing it with exact expansion-of-difference comparison made the 11-test run pass. Mathematical equations and coefficients were unchanged.
The paired algebraic-direction obstruction cannot rule out a closed form for beta alone: the contact equation has a solution at beta=3*pi/4.
Failure of direct algebraic exponential substitution does not exclude all Lambert-W transformations.
Neither a non-elementary function nor a transcendental constant automatically lacks a finite elementary expression.
